title: WellaPath ingestion envelope contract
description: The boundary across which governed artifact publication output would one day be offered to the Backend. INACTIVE: no route accepts an envelope, no module outside src/manifest/** imports the code that validates one, and GET /config is unchanged. Source of truth is src/manifest/ingestion/contract.ts; tests/unit/ingestion-contract-sync.test.ts fails if this schema drifts from it. An envelope carries identity and digests, never bytes, never a URL, never a credential. Passing one stage never implies the next: received is not staged, staged is not published, published is not active, approval is not activation, and a merged upstream commit is not publication authorization.

envelope_version.description: Semantic version of this envelope contract. A consumer MUST reject any major it does not support.

manifest_contract_version.description: The manifest contract the descriptor is written against. A different value is refused rather than interpreted.

manifest_schema_sha256.description: Digest of the published manifest schema. A mismatch is CONTRACT_PIN_DRIFT: producer and consumer do not agree on the contract.

descriptor.description: An artifact descriptor exactly as manifest contract 1.1.0 defines it. Validated by the manifest contract's own validator, not by a second copy of the rules.

object_key.description: Immutable object key, derivable from the identity. Never reused for changed content; rebinding it is OBJECT_KEY_MUTABLE.

requested_operation.description: Exactly one operation. Each has its own authorization requirement; none is implied by another.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied replay key. The same key with the same payload is an idempotent no-op; the same key with a different payload is REPLAY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH, never a guess at which was meant.

predecessor.description: Lineage only. Naming a predecessor authorizes nothing.

synthetic.description: Declares that this envelope names no real object. Required true by the synthetic test-only trust mode.

artifact_identity.description: Identity is the triple. Two of the three is not an identity.

source_commit.description: A full commit id. Never a branch name: a branch names whatever it happens to point at.

provenance.description: Where the envelope came from. Absent provenance is PROVENANCE_MISSING; an envelope of unknown origin is never ingested.

authorizations.description: Each operation cites its own decision. Absence is not authorization, and authorization for one operation is never authorization for another.

trust_mode.description: `production` currently always fails with SIGNATURE_POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: no signing algorithm, trusted key source, custody model, rotation process or verification policy has been approved. `synthetic_test_only` is refused outside development, requires synthetic: true, and never produces an operative receipt.

claimed_signed.description: The producer's claim. It is recorded and never trusted; the outcome is identical whether it is true or false.

signature_ref.description: Opaque reference to a signature, when one exists. Never key material.

target_schema_version.description: The target's own schema version. A rollback crossing a schema boundary is refused with ROLLBACK_SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE and ROLLBACK_POLICY_UNRESOLVED: no cross-schema rollback policy has been approved, and none is invented here.

rollback_identity.description: A rollback target is bound by version AND digest. A version-only target points at whatever that version happens to be.
